_help: nullCAT Channel Exporter settings. Put this file next to NullcatChannelExporter.dll in your SimHub folder and restart SimHub. Lines starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
_help_host: Where nullCAT listens: the Pi or PC running nullCAT, and the same UDP port as your motion telemetry (default 4444). nullCAT tells the streams apart by their headers.
_help_channels: Twelve channels need no setup and are always sent: rpm, speed, gear, clutch, throttle, brake, ABS active, rev limiter (computed from rpm vs the car max), TC active, the car max rpm, turbo boost and the pit limiter. They drive the Engine, Gear shift, ABS, Limiter and TC effects in nullCAT. The game and car names are sent once a second.
_help_presets: Assetto Corsa, Competizione, EVO, Rally and Automobilista 2 need NOTHING below: the plugin knows which per-wheel fields each of them exposes (wheel speeds, loads, combined slip, suspension travel or velocity, a real slip ratio where the game has one) and sends them by itself. Fill a group in only to override that, or for a game the plugin does not know.
_help_props: Everything below is OPTIONAL. Each value is the full name of ANY SimHub property. Find names in SimHub under Settings, Properties (copy the exact text, dots included), or make your own with an NCalc formula. ShakeIt effects can also be exported as properties from the effect's settings and then appear in the same list. Leave a value empty and that channel is not sent (or comes from the built-in preset for a known game).
_help_name_shape: A property name looks like PluginName.Section.ValueName, for example DataCorePlugin.GameData.Brake (that one is the brake, 0..100, and is already sent automatically). The game's raw fields are under DataCorePlugin.GameRawData.
_help_magnitudes: The four magnitudes are 0..100 summaries. skid and lockup are the FALLBACK for the two slip effects when the per-wheel channels below are not bound: they feed all four wheels at once.
_help_skidProp: Tyre slip magnitude 0..100: fallback for the Lateral slip effect.
_help_lockupProp: Brake lockup magnitude 0..100: fallback for the Longitudinal slip effect.
_help_roadProp: Road surface texture 0..100: drives the Road effect.
_help_curbsProp: Kerb strike magnitude 0..100: drives the Kerb effect.
_help_wheels: Per-wheel channels, RAW physics, no shaping: nullCAT holds the tyre model. A group is sent only when all four wheels (FL, FR, RL, RR) are bound. Each group has a Scale for unit conversion (the value is multiplied by it before sending).
_help_slipAngle: Tyre slip angle per wheel in DEGREES, signed: drives the Lateral slip effect (scrub at the fronts, slide at the rears). Set slipAngleScale to 57.2958 if the game gives radians.
_help_slipRatio: Longitudinal slip ratio per wheel, signed: negative = the wheel turns slower than the road (locking), positive = faster (spinning), -1 = fully locked. Drives the Longitudinal slip effect. If the game gives it as a percentage, set slipRatioScale to 0.01.
_help_wheelSpeed: Wheel rotational speed per wheel in ANY unit (rev/s, rad/s, km/h at the tread): used for the Longitudinal slip effect when the game has no slip ratio. nullCAT learns each wheel's rolling factor against road speed while you cruise, so no radius or unit setup is needed.
_help_load: Vertical tyre load per wheel in any unit: the loaded tyre's slip is weighted up. Optional.
_help_suspVel: Suspension velocity per corner in mm/s, signed: the Road effect replays each corner from these. Set suspVelScale to 1000 if the game gives m/s.
_help_suspTravel: Suspension travel per corner in mm, signed, for games that give position rather than velocity: the Road effect takes the bumps out of it. Set suspTravelScale to 1000 if the game gives metres.
_help_wheelSlip: Combined tyre slip per wheel (the game's own slip magnitude), 0..100 with 100 = the tyre has let go: the Lateral slip effect's source where the game has no slip angle. Set wheelSlipScale so that a clear slide reads about 100 (Assetto Corsa's wheelSlip, which reads about 6 at a clear slide: 16.7; a slip speed in m/s: 20).
